target.title: test(qa): stabilize native command active-session scenario
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99655.

`qa/scenarios/channels/native-command-session-target.yaml` had two contention-sensitive lifecycle races:

1. The 5000ms `hasActiveRun` assertion could start while an isolated gateway was still completing cold provider/auth/model preparation.
2. The scenario sent recovery immediately after the native `/stop` acknowledgement, although acknowledgement can precede aborted-run cleanup and session-lane release.

The first race occurred in current-main runs 28676119315 and 28679216025. Exact-head run 28684401187, job 85074374151, artifact 8075163886 proved the first candidate warmup fixed admission but exposed the second race: `/stop` acknowledged, recovery was sent, and the final wait expired while abort cleanup still owned the lane.

## Why This Change Was Made

The scenario now:

- completes one real Crabline Telegram warmup turn before starting the unchanged 5000ms active-run assertion;
- keeps the native `/stop` and abort acknowledgement assertions unchanged;
- waits for the same session’s `hasActiveRun` projection to clear after acknowledgement;
- sends recovery only after the aborted run is no longer active, while keeping the existing 15000ms recovery assertion unchanged.

This synchronizes on real lifecycle state instead of adding sleeps or weakening measured assertions. JSONL partial-tail parsing is not touched.

## User Impact

QA Smoke CI can exercise native `/stop` reliably under cold-start and abort-cleanup contention. The scenario still proves the same command targeting, acknowledgement, and next-turn recovery behavior.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts`
  - 1 file passed, 32 tests passed.
- Revised exact scenario command used `--provider-mode mock-openai --channel-driver crabline --channel telegram --scenario native-command-session-target --concurrency 1`.
  - Four concurrent workers: 4/4 passed.
  - Every summary reported `channelDriver: crabline`, `channel: telegram`, `Agent was aborted`, and `QA-NATIVE-STOP-RECOVERY-OK`.
- Blacksmith Testbox changed gate for the revision:
  - Provider: `blacksmith-testbox`
  - ID: `tbx_01kwmz6a4c7s72g5z9k9h8459e`
  - Exit: 0
  - All-project typecheck, lint, repository guards, and import-cycle checks passed.
- Fresh autoreview for the revision:
  - `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`
  - Clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- `git diff --check`
  - Passed.
